fieldValues.title: A live transcript beside the minutes, linked by time and by selection
fieldValues.move: Show the transcript arriving in a panel beside the editor during a meeting, streamed from the local transcription engine on the same machine (server-sent events), with a local model's flags on what may be a decision. Store a time window on each minute as it is started, let the writer select the words a minute came from, and after the meeting have an agent propose further links for a tick or deny (srs-web#617). A flag becomes a record only when the writer accepts it.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not make the transcript more accurate or name speakers. It does not make the local model's flags reliable beyond potential decisions: measured on a real meeting, its decision flags held, but its action items, open questions and topics did not (semanticops.com#65). It does not work in a browser that blocks the page from reaching the engine on localhost until the person allows local network access (Chrome 148; Brave untested).
fieldValues.falsifier: Writers ignore the panel and take minutes as before; or the transcript's lag (measured 2026-11-09: median about 10 s, 90th percentile about 15 to 16 s, worst about 20 s) makes the time window point at the wrong words too often to be useful; or the flags are wrong often enough that writers stop reading them.
